responsibility: This header declares the small C interface for gm2 top-level compilation control: entering or leaving the global context and setting GCC’s unit-at-a-time compilation flag. It is the declaration companion to the lightweight backend-control stubs in m2top.cc.
same_name_distinction: C/C++ header for the m2top group: it provides extern declarations for the global-context and unit-at-a-time control hooks, while m2top.def is the Modula-2 foreign-definition form and m2top.cc defines the functions.
